title: STANLEY IceFlow 2.0 Flip Straw Tumbler, 30 oz, Rose Quartz | Easy Carry Handle | Twist On Lid and Flip Up Straw | Leak Resistant Water Bottle | Insulated Stainless Steel | BPA-Free

reviews.title: Stylish, Leakproof, and Keeps Drinks Cold!
reviews.body: I absolutely love this Stanley tumbler! The color is even more beautiful in person, and the quality is exactly what I expected. It's sturdy, easy to carry, and fits perfectly in my car's cup holder.The Flip Straw lid is super convenient and truly leakproof, so I can toss it in my bag without worrying about spills. It keeps my water cold for hours, even on hot days.It's easy to clean, comfortable to hold, and perfect for everyday use. If you're looking for a high-quality tumbler that looks great and performs even better, I highly recommend it!

reviews.title: Keeps Drinks Cold for Hours and Easy to Carry
reviews.body: I've tried a lot of tumblers over the years, and this one has quickly become my favorite. The insulation works extremely well—ice stays frozen for hours, and my drinks remain cold throughout the day, even when I'm out and about.The flip-up straw is convenient and easy to use, and I like that it tucks away when not in use. The lid feels secure, and I haven't experienced any leaking during normal use. The handle makes it comfortable to carry, especially when traveling, commuting, or running errands.The 30 oz size is a good balance between capacity and portability. It holds enough water to reduce refill trips but still fits comfortably in most cup holders. The tumbler also feels durable and well-made, with the high-quality construction I've come to expect.Cleaning is straightforward, and the design looks great in person. Overall, this is an excellent tumbler for staying hydrated throughout the day and well worth the investment.

reviews.title: Can’t go wrong with Stanley
reviews.body: I got this to use on my motorcycle. It fits in my cupholder like it was made for it and it has a flip up mouthpiece with a long plastic straw down the center of it so you don’t have to tip your head back and take your eyes off the road. Keeps drinks cold. I have not used it for coffee or anything of that nature and it does not sweat. Comes in multiple colors and this particular one comes in two sizes 30 ounce and 40 ounce. It’s a little pricey, but you’re paying for quality.

reviews.title: Best travel bottle ever
reviews.body: Always loved my one with the straw but this one is more functional for a on the go lifestyle and travel. No leakage. Hold ice, nugget ice does melt within an hour but larger ice cubes last longer. Well made. Always worth the purchase. Purchased 3 of these in different colors.

reviews.title: Great water bottle
reviews.body: Pretty great water bottle. Bought for kids; it's a little big for kids but they like the bottle. It fits into a car cup holder, though I don't love the wider upper area design for putting into backpacks, however it is easier to clean than thinner bottles. The handle swivels (very useful for kids versus a fixed handle). Great colors. Very durable. No issues with the straw.

reviews.title: So easy to carry
reviews.body: This is the perfect size for travel and the color is beautiful. I love the ease of the handle and how easy it is to carry without feeling bulky. My water stays cold all day and it’s keeps ice for hours. I like the ability to close the straw and not have to worry about spills.

reviews.title: Keeps my drink cold
reviews.body: I like this water bottle, if I add ice it keeps my water or cold drink nice and cold, even if it's sitting in a hot car. The build is solid, the handle is easy to carry and not flimsy. This is a well made, quality bottle as are all the Stanley bottles.The only thing I don't care for, and this is me being picky, is the straw mouth part is too thick. I would prefer a thinner straw to drink from.But honestly it's a good bottle and feels like it will last forever. You can't go wrong with Stanley cups and bottles.

features: Sip Faster, Spill Less: The Flip Straw 2.0 lid is designed for quick hydration. Just flip up to sip and snap it shut for a leak resistant seal. Perfect for your bag, commute, or workout.
Cold for 20 Hours, Iced for Days: Stay refreshed wherever you go! Double-wall vacuum insulation keeps your drink cold for 20 hours or iced for up to 3 days, so you can hydrate longer without refills.

Upgraded for On-the-Go: This tumbler is built for life in motion with an easy-carry handle and cupholder-compatible base. Whether you're running errands or heading to the gym, hydration is always within reach.
Durable, Sustainable, & Easy to Clean: Made with 18/8 recycled stainless steel, this BPA-free tumbler is tough enough for everyday use and dishwasher safe for effortless cleaning.
Designed for Convenience: The removable spout and replaceable seal make cleaning and maintenance a breeze, so your tumbler stays fresh and functional for years to come.
